propositions: Capability-gap findings from plan-review R1 (via asserted-capability probe) require a dedicated verification counterpart in code-review Pass-2 to confirm or refute the claimed gap on evidence

asserted_capability_confirmed must be added to the shared GRADED_BINARY kernel vocabulary as an na-default graded sub-answer with yes=finding-holds polarity (yes=1.0, insufficient=0.5, no=0.0) to prevent false non-delivery claims from riding on unearned validity

The field must operate on the validity axis only—not impact promotion—so a no answer (capability is delivered) drops the finding's validity by reflecting it as a false positive rather than coupling to divergent_implementation

Both plan-review and code-review Binary models must inherit asserted_capability_confirmed through the shared _build_binary() path with na as the default outside the G6/E4/T3 asserted-capability cohort

The change requires E5 byte-identical replay (no validity/decision/priority diff over the 161-row corpus with na defaults outside the cohort) and E6 consistency κ≥0.6 (recorded κ=0.874) before landing

IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must NOT be bumped because the field is a validity-axis-only correction that neither changes impact_code nor impact_plan shape, and byte-identical property requires sidecars remain un-segmented
